entries.title: SimCity

emulation.notes: Use a clean Super NES/Super Famicom dump, preserve 4:3 output, and avoid fan hacks for the baseline archive run.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Super NES 2D presentation scaled cleanly through modern emulator capture.

primary.version: Nintendo Super NES version via emulator
primary.why: The original SimCity released across many computer and console platforms, while the Super NES version keeps the core gameplay and scenario structure but adds Nintendo-developed content: Dr. Wright, Bowser replacing the monster disaster, reward buildings, a Mario statue, a bank/loan system, and two extra scenarios. For Sami's route, the Super NES version is the best single main run because it is the most content-rich version and can be captured cleanly through modern SNES emulation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Super NES version in a high-accuracy emulator such as bsnes or Snes9x with integer 4:3 scaling. Use original DOS/Mac/Amiga builds only when documenting the earliest Maxis computer presentation.

entries.remaster_caveats: There is no modern remaster in this batch. The Micropolis/open-source lineage is historically important but is not a branded SimCity replacement for this archive entry.

entries.title: SimCity 2000

emulation.notes: The Special Edition is powered by DOSBox and was verified for Windows 10/11 compatibility through its Preservation Program.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: DOS/CD Special Edition presentation with DOSBox scaling and modern capture.

primary.version: GOG SimCity 2000 Special Edition / CD Collection DOSBox release
primary.why: SimCity 2000 released across DOS, Macintosh, Windows, Amiga, Acorn, PC-98, FM Towns, SNES, Saturn, PlayStation, Nintendo 64, mobile, and later PlayStation Network. The complete route is the CD Collection/Special Edition lineage, which includes the base game, Great Disasters scenario pack, Urban Renewal Kit, and bonus cities/scenarios; GOG sells SimCity 2000 Special Edition with the Urban Renewal Kit goodie and a DOSBox-powered Windows/Mac package verified for modern Windows. That gives Sami the cleanest current complete-content route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GOG SimCity 2000 Special Edition build. Keep the bundled DOSBox configuration stable for capture; use original Windows/Mac discs only for historical comparison or if a specific UI comparison is being documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: The GOG build is DOSBox-powered. Treat Windows 95/Macintosh ports as historical comparison routes unless exclusive content missing from the Special Edition path is found in the future.

entries.title: SimCity 3000

emulation.notes: Use the GOG Preservation Program build first. GOG's support article says widescreen is not supported by default and provides a modified executable for higher screen resolutions.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows 2D presentation with GOG-supported 1080p modes; higher resolutions are possible only with support/manual fixes.

primary.version: SimCity 3000 Unlimited on GOG or Steam
primary.why: The original SimCity 3000 released on Windows and Macintosh, and SimCity 3000 Unlimited followed as a 2000 Windows/Linux re-release. Unlimited adds two building sets, new scenarios, new disasters, a scenario creator, seasonal events, and the Building Architect Tool, and the current GOG build adds Preservation Program compatibility work including DDrawCompat, stability validation, Windows 10/11 verification, cloud saves, and up to 1080p resolution modes. Windows PC Unlimited is therefore the most complete and best current fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play SimCity 3000 Unlimited on GOG for the preservation updates, or Steam if that is the available library copy. Use the GOG widescreen support article only if higher resolution behavior needs manual repair, and keep an original executable backup before replacing files.

entries.remaster_caveats: GOG's current build unlocks up to 1080p modes and applies DDrawCompat. Higher or unusual widescreen resolutions may require the GOG support executable or manual fixes, so preserve the original executable before experimenting.

entries.title: SimCity 4

emulation.notes: Use the current Windows Deluxe build. For launch issues, GOG recommends adding -CPUCount:1 -w -CustomResolution:enabled and a chosen -rWIDTHxHEIGHTx32 value.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC 3D/isometric presentation with custom resolution flags and community mod capacity.

primary.version: SimCity 4 Deluxe Edition on GOG or Steam
primary.why: SimCity 4 released for Windows and Macintosh/Mac OS X, with Rush Hour as the official expansion. Deluxe Edition is the base game plus Rush Hour. The Windows PC Deluxe route is the archive pick because it combines the full official gameplay package with the best capture/settings/modding path and current GOG/Steam availability.
primary.how_to_play: Play SimCity 4 Deluxe Edition on Windows PC, preferably GOG for the DRM-free archive copy or Steam if that is the available library copy. If modern Windows has launch or graphics trouble, use GOG's documented windowed/custom-resolution/CPU-count shortcut flags.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a maintained classic digital release rather than a remaster. Newer systems may have performance/graphics issues, and windowed or compatibility mode is recommended; -CPUCount:1, windowed mode, and custom-resolution flags are available for launching issues.

entries.title: SimCity BuildIt
entries.definitive_edition: Current official iOS/Android SimCity BuildIt client with account/event/version state documented

emulation.emulator: Android emulator only if real device capture is impractical
emulation.notes: Prefer real iOS/Android device because account, ads, purchases, and device compatibility matter.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official mobile client on supported device

primary.version: Current SimCity BuildIt live mobile client
primary.why: BuildIt is a free-to-play live mobile SimCity entry, so the current iOS/Android client is the archive authority. Completeness is defined by account/city state, seasonal content, clubs/contests, store/web-store availability, platform account linkage, and event timing rather than a fixed campaign.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current iOS or Android build. Record app version, device/OS, account linkage, city level/population, regions, club/contest state, event/season, in-app purchase state, ads, offline/online behavior, and whether Google Play/App Store/Amazon builds differ.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting Amazon/alternate Android availability.
secondary.why: Main iOS/Google Play routes represent the live game for most archive use.

secondary.exclusive_content: Retired events, balance, buildings, monetization, and city-system versions
secondary.what_to_play: Document from dated captures or patch notes only.
secondary.why: The current client does not preserve every past live-service state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Recheck app version and service status before every archive run. Do not treat BuildIt as interchangeable with PC SimCity entries.

entries.title: SimCity Societies
entries.definitive_edition: Owned Windows PC copy with SimCity Societies: Destinations installed

emulation.notes: Native Windows route with compatibility fixes as needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Patched Windows PC install with Destinations expansion documented

primary.version: Owned PC release with Destinations expansion if available
primary.why: SimCity Societies is a Windows-only city-builder spin on the SimCity formula, and the Destinations expansion adds the most complete official content scope. Current availability is not as clean as the classic GOG SimCity routes, so an owned/preserved PC install with expansion and patch state documented is the honest archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Windows PC copy with the latest patch and Destinations expansion if available. Record source, patch, expansion state, scenario/map, values/society profile, tourism systems, resolution/performance fixes, DRM/EA app state, and whether the base game was compared without Destinations.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting launch behavior separately.
secondary.why: Destinations adds systems and content that change the complete route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record expansion/patch/DRM state. Do not merge with SimCity (2013), SimCity 4, or SimCity BuildIt.
